name: Live activation: intent, accepted order and independent observation match
Normal fill updates inventory, reservation and fees exactly once
Healthy book: configured stay-out / join rule
Stale feed: independent watchdog attempts cancel without new ticks
evidence: contracts test_staleShutdownWithoutAnyNewTick; keeper outage integration test

name: Volatility trigger, cancellation and resume conditions
Loss trigger: shutdown, overshoot and residual inventory disclosed
Delayed cancel / partial fill: reservations stay conservative, late fills reconcile
evidence: keeper integration (delayed cancel + partial fill, rejected cancel retry); contracts test_cancelRequestKeepsReservationUntilConfirmed

name: Replay / out-of-order outcomes: no duplicated accounting or fees
evidence: contracts test_observationReplayRejected, test_outcomeBatchReplayRejected, test_fillBeforeAckOutOfOrder, duplicate fill check

name: Keeper outage / restart: no new exposure before reconciliation
evidence: keeper integration: restart recovery, keeper outage with exchange-side scheduled cancel

name: Mismatched order: watcher detects, alerts and blocks new exposure
Owner exit: revocation and remaining-order checks confirmed separately
